_note: Bitcoin oscillator v1 (21-Nov-2026), indicative. 5-yr Bear/Base/Bull paths (USD, Nov of each year), tax/cost layer for a resident Indian investor, and the satellite position-size rule. Judgment-based; change only deliberately and log it in btc-run-procedure.md section 7.

Bear.story: No clean 4-year cycle: Fed keeps hiking into 2027, ETF and treasury-company holders keep selling, the 2028-29 rally is weak and BTC ends below today's price.

Base.story: Cycle rhymes with smaller swings: trough by mid-2027, the 2028 halving rally peaks near $150k in late 2029, then a mid-bear market by Nov-31.

Bull.story: Recession forces Fed cuts, real yields fall below 1%, the dollar weakens and ETF and sovereign demand returns: a $260k peak in 2029.

tax._note: Resident individual, FY2026-27. Budget 2026 (1-Feb-2026) kept the VDA regime unchanged. Verify with a tax adviser before acting.
tax.vda_rate_note: 30% flat on VDA gains + 4% cess; surcharge on top for income above Rs 50 lakh (not capped at 15% for VDA income)
tax.vda_loss_note: VDA losses cannot be set off against any income (including other VDA gains) and cannot be carried forward; only cost of acquisition is deductible
tax.tds_note: 1% TDS on every sale/transfer consideration; credited against tax, refunded via ITR when the trade is a loss (assumed 1-year lag)
tax.vda_cost_note: Indian exchange: ~0.2-0.5% fee each side + 18% GST on fees + spread/INR premium; est.
tax.etf_note: US-listed spot BTC ETF bought via LRS: treated as foreign securities, not VDA (to confirm). Held >24 months: LTCG 12.5%; losses can be set off against other capital gains (valued here at 12.5%). Cost = ~0.25% ER + remittance/FX spread amortised; 20% TCS above Rs 10 lakh/yr is creditable but locks cash; US estate-tax exposure above $60k.

sizing._note: Satellite cap as % of total investable portfolio = min(band cap, loss budget / stress drawdown). Losses on VDA are not tax-deductible, so the full stress loss counts; on the ETF route the loss is shielded at the LTCG rate.
